description: Say which VK token the server holds — a community token, a user token, a VK ID sign-in token or an app service key — which community it acts as and with which rights, which tools work with it, and for each tool that does not, what would make it work. Call it when unsure what you can do in VK, or before telling the user something cannot be done.
name: vk_token_info

community.description: The community a community token acts as: id, name, screen_name

kind.description: community, user, vkid (a VK ID sign-in token), service (an app service key), none, or unknown when VK could not say

scopes.description: Rights a community token was issued with, as VK names them

service_key.description: Whether VK_SERVICE_KEY is set; reads the token is refused are made with it

tools.description: Tools that work with the configured tokens

unavailable.description: Tools that do not, each with what would make it work

title: What the VK token can do
